title: Public Investments Financial Safeguards Amendment Ordinance 2006

sections.shortTitle: Public Investments Financial Safeguards Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 2006
ORDINANCE II OF 2006
Public Investments
(Financial Safeguards) (Amendment)
Ordinance 2006
An
Ordinance further to amend the Public Investments (Financial Safeguards)
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 14th
March, 2006]
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Public Investments (Financial Safeguards)
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2006.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 25th December, 2005.

2. Amendment of section 4,
Ordinance XLVI of 1960.--In the
Public Investments (Financial Safeguards) Ordinance, 1960 (XLVI of 1960),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 4,--‑
(a) for the
words, comma and figure "Companies Act, 1913" the words, comma and
figure Companies Ordinance, 1984" shall be substituted; and
(b) in the
margin, for the figures and word "VII
of 1913" the figures and word. "XLVII of 1984" shall be
substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Public Investments Financial Safeguards Amendment Ordinance 2006
sections.description:
Insertion of section 9A, Ordinance XLVI of 1960

ORDINANCE II OF 2006
ORDINANCE II OF 2006
Public Investments
(Financial Safeguards) (Amendment)
Ordinance 2006
An
Ordinance further to amend the Public Investments (Financial Safeguards)
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 14th
March, 2006]
3. Insertion of section 9A,
Ordinance XLVI of 1960.--In the
said Ordinance, after section 9, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:‑
"9A. Ordinance
not to apply to certain bodies corporate, etc.--(1) Notwithstanding
anything in this Ordinance a body corporate, company, institution undertaking
and establishment, specified in the Schedule to this Ordinance, upon
privatization pursuant to the Privatization Commission Ordinance, 2000 (LII of 2000) shall not be deemed to be a body
corporate, corporation, institution, undertaking or establishment established
with the aid of public revenues of the Federation or the Federal Government for
the purposes of this Ordinance.
(2) The Federal
Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, amend the schedule so
as to add any entry thereto, modify or omit any entry therein".
